name: codex-usage-passport
description: Starts a local BLE bridge that shows Codex usage and permission prompts on a FoloToy AI Passport.

interface.shortDescription: Passport companion for Codex usage and approvals
interface.longDescription: Starts a local Python BLE bridge. The bridge reads local Codex usage and forwards permission prompts to an AI Passport running the Codex Buddy firmware. Nothing is sent to an external server.
